_comment: Which sales to alert on, and how far ahead to warn you.
_watchTitlePatterns_note: Case-insensitive substring match against the sale's title on the LFC match page. Add 'all red members ticket sale' if you also want alerts on the twice-yearly ballot sale.
_onlyOpponents_note: Empty = every men's home game at Anfield. Otherwise e.g. ["fulham", "arsenal"] to narrow it down.
_reminderLeadMinutes_note: Advance warnings before a registration window opens or a sale starts: 24 hours, 1 hour, 10 minutes.
_heartbeatDays_note: Send a short 'still watching, nothing new' email at most this often, so silence is never ambiguous. 0 disables it.
